subject.name: Psychodiagnostics
subject.course_or_branch: BA in Socialogy Psychology Political Science

content: Introduction to Psychodiagnostics, Definition Concept and
Description, Methods of Behavioural Assessment, Assessment in
Clinical Psychology, Ethical Issues in Assessment
Psychodiagnostics in Psychology, Objectives of Psychodiagnostics
Different Stages in Psychodiagnostics, Batteries of Test and
Measures of Intelligence and Conceptual Thinking, Intelligence
Testing - Malin’s Intelligence Scale for Indian Children, Binet
Kamat test, Weschler’s Adult Intelligence Scale, Measurement of
Memory and Creativity, Utility of Data from The Test of Cognitive
Functions, Screening tests: Mini-Mental Status Examination
Introduction to Projective Techniques, Principles of Measurement
and Projective Techniques - Rorschach Inkblot Test, Thematic
Apperception Test, Semi Projective Tests - Sack’s Sentence
Completion Test, Personality Inventories, Psychodiagnostics report
